usage: Exact JSON Schema fragments for the NEW argument shapes. The MCP manifest (internal/manifest/capabilities.json) and the Gateway dispatch schemas (schemas/*.json) must contain these fragments byte-equivalent (same keywords and values; key order free). Existing branches stay unchanged (D-080). 'Δ' entries describe how an existing schema changes.

source.file.upload.Δ: file.properties.mime_type: replace {const:text/csv} with #/$defs/uploadMediaType. When mime_type is absent the MCP derives it from file_name (.csv, .xlsx, case-insensitive); when neither gives a known type the MCP uses text/csv (historical behaviour, D-080) and the owner content check decides. GeoPackage joins the enum with F3.

source.file.profile.Δ: add optional property readOptions: #/$defs/xlsxReadOptions. Same asset + same readOptions -> same profile (idempotent); different readOptions -> new profile version. Owner rejects readOptions on a non-XLSX asset with 422 ONB_READ_OPTIONS_UNSUPPORTED.

source.file.preview.Δ: top-level properties: view.enum gains UNITS and UNIT; add unitRef (#/$defs/unitRef). oneOf gains exactly the three branches below. Existing branches unchanged.

source.analysis.plan.Δ: required becomes [expectedRevision, work]; add property unitProfileRef (#/$defs/unitProfileRef); add the oneOf below. All other properties unchanged.

source.onboarding.create.Δ: required loses assetId and profileId; add property unitProfileRef (#/$defs/unitProfileRef); add the anyOf below. When unitProfileRef is present, assetId/profileId/layer are optional and, if present, must agree (owner: 409 ONB_UNIT_SELECTION_CHANGED).

source.onboarding.review.prepare.Δ: add optional property unitProfileRef (#/$defs/unitProfileRef); executionProposal becomes {oneOf:[<typed-csv:v2 unchanged>, <managed-unit v1>]} where managed-unit v1 = the typed-csv:v2 schema with: $id 'urn:ouf:managed-unit-execution-proposal:v1'; required gains 'contract'; properties gains contract {const:'ouf.managed-unit-execution-proposal.v1'}; description updated to be format-neutral. udp stays closed exactly as in typed-csv:v2 (udp.spatial is added with F3). typed-csv:v2 must NOT gain a 'contract' property, so the two branches are mutually exclusive.

source.onboarding.revision.prepare.Δ: add optional property unitProfileRef (#/$defs/unitProfileRef): the incoming unit of a replacement, as an alternative to assetRef. Exactly one of assetRef or unitProfileRef in the replacement branch; unitProfileRef is forbidden together with changes. newColumns rules apply to both replacement forms.
